name: Tag name

pillPlaceholder.note: Shown in the preview pill while the name is empty. Lowercase.

automaticHint: Automatic picks a colour from the tag’s name, so no two tags next to each other look alike. Renaming the tag picks another one.

scope.some: Offered only when one of these categories (or a category in a selected folder) is chosen.
scope.all: Nothing selected: the tag is offered for every category.

convert.rowSubtitle: {count, plural, one {Moves # transaction to a new category and removes the tag} other {Moves # transactions to a new category and removes the tag}}
convert.topSubtitle: Becomes a folder of its own

theFolder.note: Stands in for a folder name that cannot be found.

body.message: {count, plural, one {# transaction will get the category “{name}” and lose the tag.} other {# transactions will get the category “{name}” and lose the tag.}} The tag is removed.
body.note: name is the tag, which becomes the category's name.

bodyFolder.message: {count, plural, one {# transaction will get the category “{name}” in {folder} and lose the tag.} other {# transactions will get the category “{name}” in {folder} and lose the tag.}} The tag is removed.
bodyFolder.note: name is the tag, folder the folder the new category goes into.

archive.rowSubtitle: Keeps every transaction and every budget; just stops being offered
archive.restoreSubtitle: Offered again everywhere it used to be
archive.tripSubtitle: Not while travel mode is using it — end travel mode first
archive.tripTitle: Travel mode is using this tag
archive.tripBody: It is being put on everything you log right now. End travel mode first — on its card at the top of Transactions, or in Settings — then archive the tag.
archive.title: Archive this tag?
archive.keep: {count, plural, one {Its # transaction keeps it, and a budget on it still counts.} other {Its # transactions keep it, and a budget on it still counts.}}
archive.rules: {count, plural, one {# recurring rule still puts it on what it posts — open it if that is not what you want.} other {# recurring rules still put it on what they post — open those if that is not what you want.}}
archive.offered: It stops being offered for anything new.
